interaction_history.overview: A mentally unstable Vietnam War veteran works as a night-time taxi driver in New York City where the perceived decadence and sleaze feeds his urge for violent action, attempting to save a preadolescent prostitute in the process.
interaction_history.title: Taxi Driver

interaction_history.overview: Two bounty hunters are in pursuit of "El Indio," one of the most wanted fugitives in the western territories, and his gang.
interaction_history.title: For a Few Dollars More

interaction_history.overview: A small-town doctor learns that the population of his community is being replaced by emotionless alien duplicates.
interaction_history.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers

interaction_history.overview: A chronicle of the original Mercury astronauts in the formation of America's space program: Alan Shepherd, the first American in space; Gus Grissom, the benighted astronaut for whom nothing works out as planned; John Glenn, the straight-arrow 'boy scout' of the bunch who was the first American to orbit the earth; and the remaining pilots: Deke Slayton, Scott Carpenter and Wally Schirra.
interaction_history.title: Right Stuff, The

interaction_history.overview: Robert Neville, a doctor, due to an experimental vaccine, is the only survivor of an apocalyptic war waged with biological weapons. The plague caused by the war has killed everyone else except for a few hundred deformed, nocturnal people calling themselves "The Family". The plague has caused them to become sensitive to light, as well as homicidally psychotic.
interaction_history.title: Omega Man, The

interaction_history.overview: A recent college graduate finds himself in a love triangle with an older woman and her daughter.
interaction_history.title: Graduate, The

interaction_history.overview: A naive male prostitute and his sickly friend struggle to survive on the streets of New York City.
interaction_history.title: Midnight Cowboy

interaction_history.overview: A woman struggles to find a way to live her life after the death of her husband and child.
interaction_history.title: Three Colors: Blue

interaction_history.overview: Bonnie and Clyde is based on the true stories of the gangster pair Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow who in the 1930s began robbing banks in U.S. cities until they were eventually killed. The film is a major landmark in the aesthetic movement known as the New Hollywood.
interaction_history.title: Bonnie and Clyde

interaction_history.overview: Fast Eddie Felson is a small-time pool hustler with a lot of talent but a self-destructive attitude. His bravado causes him to challenge the legendary Minnesota Fats to a high-stakes match.
interaction_history.title: Hustler, The
